description: BusSense Large Public & Internal Dataset Inventory (Physically Audited on Disk)

datasets.sequence_information: Continuous driving sequence at 10-30 km/h, synchronized left/right stereo frames (74 pairs)
datasets.bussense_task: Primary end-to-end stereo perception, disparity estimation, 3D road metrology, and output video rendering

datasets.dataset: KITTI Vision Benchmark Stereo Driving Sequences
datasets.source: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology & Toyota Technological Institute (Geiger et al.)
datasets.sequence_information: Moving urban/arterial stereo vehicle sequence with calibrated camera baseline B=0.54m
datasets.bussense_task: Cross-domain moving stereo verification, vehicle tracking, incident intelligence

datasets.dataset: IIIT-H IDD (India Driving Dataset Domain Slices)
datasets.source: AutoNUE / IIIT Hyderabad (Varma et al.) & Indian Road Drives
datasets.license: IIIT Hyderabad Academic License / CC BY 4.0
datasets.sequence_information: Unstructured Indian road corridor drives with multi-agent traffic and diverse road conditions
datasets.bussense_task: Indian driving domain calibration, road appearance generalization, real model replay

datasets.dataset: IIIT-H MTSVD / GTSDB (Traffic Sign Detection Benchmark)
datasets.source: IIIT Hyderabad & German Traffic Sign Detection Benchmark
datasets.sequence_information: Standardized traffic sign sequences with precise bounding box coordinates and categorized taxonomies
datasets.bussense_task: Traffic sign detection, condition classification, missing-sign reasoning validation

datasets.dataset: CeyMo Road Marking & Zebra Crossing Dataset
datasets.sequence_information: High-resolution 1080p road surface marking captures in South Asian road environments
datasets.bussense_task: Pedestrian zebra crossing segmentation, paint wear metrology, missing crossing validation

datasets.sequence_information: Flooded urban roadway scenes with paired pixel-accurate binary water masks
datasets.bussense_task: Road surface waterlogging segmentation and ego-corridor extent ratio metrology

datasets.dataset: Fan et al. Road Surface Pothole & Crack Stereo Dataset
datasets.source: Research Stereo Road Damage Benchmark (Fan et al.)
datasets.sequence_information: Paired left/right stereo road damage captures with ground depth profiles
datasets.bussense_task: 3D pothole depth metrology validation and road damage volume benchmarking
